column1: # Compiler declarations nothing reaches (scripts/tests/check_dead_code_ratchet.sh): no executable,
# theorem, proof library, tool, `#guard`/`example`, or allowlisted script reaches them. The
# baseline only SHRINKS: a new unreachable declaration fails the gate, and so does a row added
# here relative to the base revision. Delete a declaration and its row together.
# Columns: declaration (user name), kind, file, reason. Reason is `unreviewed` (seeded, not yet
# reviewed), `dead` (reviewed: to be removed), or `keep: <why>` (reviewed: kept on purpose, e.g.
# an API a docs/compiler/VERIFIED_PIPELINE.md step or a ROADMAP task plans to use).
